name: Statistical Study Workbench
reason: Need evidence for a distinct governed study/protocol/assumption/diagnostic/report lifecycle beyond notebooks and experimentation.

name: Graph Analytics Workbench
reason: Graph representation and algorithms are proven library families; an independent workbench product lifecycle remains unproved.

name: Data Access Request and Provisioning
reason: Need to separate request-case authority, entitlement provisioning, approval, revocation and marketplace fulfillment.

name: Data Observability and Incident Operations
reason: Need to determine whether data incidents have independent adoption, ownership and support or compose existing quality and operations products.

name: Sensitive-Data Discovery and Classification
reason: Likely a classification capability plus review workflow; product independence and authority remain unproved.

name: Data Migration and Modernization Control
reason: A migration programme may be a temporary solution composition rather than a durable horizontal product.

name: Operational Data Application and API Serving
reason: This may belong to the application/runtime sovereign domain rather than the analytical-data product portfolio; cross-domain ownership must be adjudicated.
